tournaments.name: Sprint
tournaments.blurb: A one-day opener: fast rounds, straight elimination, open to the whole ladder.
tournaments.summary: Every team on the ladder enters a seeded single-elimination bracket, and each match is best of 7 on unseen maps. Submissions close at 9:00 am AEST on 1 October, and the submission active then is the one that plays. Autoscrims run for about three hours after that, and seeds follow the ratings they produce. The bracket is played and streamed online from 5:30 pm AEST, with $800 for first and $400 for second.
tournaments.prizeNote: Open to every entrant. Tentative seeds follow the current rating ladder. Highest seeds receive any first-round byes.

tournaments.name: Qualifiers
tournaments.blurb: All eligible teams compete for ten places in the Grand Final.
tournaments.summary: Every eligible team enters a seeded single-elimination bracket for ten places in the Grand Final, and each match is best of 7 on unseen maps. Submissions close at 5:00 pm AEDT on 9 October, and autoscrims then run until the stream to set the seeds. The eight quarterfinalists qualify, and the eight Round-of-16 losers play a second-chance bracket, reseeded by their original seed. The two second-chance finalists take the last two places, and the event streams online from 5:30 pm AEDT on 10 October.
tournaments.entry: Seeded knockout among all eligible teams
tournaments.prizeNote: The main bracket continues to a winner. The eight Round-of-16 losers are reseeded by their original seed into a separate knockout; its two finalists also qualify.
